ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at approximately 5-8% distribution concentrated in localized spots and lines.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white speckling and linear patterns distributed across a contiguous black pixel field. Higher density of white pixel clusters is observed on the lateral regions of the right lobe compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression; narrow aperture with a defined vertical depth between the two innermost lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge. Significant pixel-depth indentations are located on the inner trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge leading toward sharp, upward-tapering distal termini (tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters distributed across both lobes. A distinct high-contrast ring-shaped (annular) mark is visible on the upper section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear streaks; several long, high-contrast diagonal marks on the right lobe and shorter, faint horizontal disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular indentations and tissue loss patterns along the trailing edge boundary. A prominent circular scar ('O' shape) is present on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense field of fine white micro-speckling ('salt and pepper' effect) across the dark pigment of both fluke lobes.
